description: NASM vendor 2.x supports reloc-abs-qword but compiler assembly warning guards use major>=3. Native semantic suite fails before executing on valid static Unicode.VERSION pointer dq. No semantic failures may be counted as passing.

review_note: Reviewed exact warning-capability matching for reloc-rel-dword and reloc-abs-qword; no broad warning disable and unknown flags avoided. Formal independent4 tests0skips source stable; mainline4 tests0skips. Real semantic debug assembly now succeeds in ELF64/COFF including prior failing valid Unicode.VERSION static-pointer relocation.
